ns2:course.label: Plasma and Fusion Science
ns2:course.description: Physics of plasmas, including particle and fluid descriptions, waves, collisions, stability, and confinement, with applications to controlled thermonuclear fusion rectors, problems in fusion engineering, and astrophysics. For engineering or physical science majors with junior standing.
ns2:course.courseSectionInformation: For engineering or physical science majors with junior standing.
